name: Yuki
source:
A girl of few words, Yuki spends most of her time in the Game Centers of Akihabara beating records and winning prizes. She also loves to collect retro video games. Although she's not interested in Idol culture at first, [url=/c121474]Ranko[/url] sees potential, and will do the impossible to convince her to join the Lewd Idol Project. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887630/]Steam[/url]]
